title: Funnel Drop-Off Deck
status: published pagelocked; pinned closed on Max's Picks and the UpKeep board
requested: Sign-up friction that can lose people mid-flow. Built from real post-#94 funnel screens (Your Plan, Your Details, and a mid-funnel step plus the browser chrome), on the latest Home and funnel stack (PR96 four-tab bar plus Get Started, boxless Share, no See What's Included on plan tiles, one-screen phone fit, Home Care, On Schedule; PR97 one-screen funnel). Not a 10-card Your Details redo, and not a remake of Where's Your Home or Sign-Up Fit. Validation errors are Legal-approved: “Enter a 10-digit U.S. phone number.” and “Enter an email address, like name@example.com.” Legal: the tagline is not paired with a promise of timing or a set arrival time.
provenance: Real funnel and Home screens from a local unlocked merge of Develop PR96 (428f746, Home section bar) and PR97 (27afbc5, one-screen funnel), served on 127.0.0.1 with every external request aborted (Google Fonts CSS answered locally with Khand and Hind; no analytics). Headless Chromium at 390x844 (deck images, dsf 2, 780x1688 JPEG q90) and 360x844 (crop QA), prefers-reduced-motion. Fictional sample person: Jordan Lee, 142 Maple Street, Novi, 48375. Nothing was submitted, paid, finished or sent.
